title: review: B5 v6 finish (T-1629 lineage): failure tests use unique ids on every task dict and no bus.read stub (review T-1632)
spec:
Goal T-1403, plan label B5-v6-fix3. Finishes B5 v6 T-1629 (held gate_red). Fresh task, NOT a resumed fix round: the Planner created your branch task/THIS-TASK at 03f5295 (the head of task/T-1629: e1c4abc B5 v6 + 03f5295 fix round 1). Your worktree is on that branch; the whole B5 v6 change is already committed there. Keep everything already committed; touch only tests/test_failures.py.

Why: the full-suite gate on e1c4abc raised KeyError: 'id' from failures._rejecting_reviews (task["id"]) in the two new tests, because their task dicts had no 'id' and earlier tests leave review rows in the shared harness bus. Fix round 1 (03f5295) passed the gate by stubbing bus.read, which review T-1632 rejected.

Change (tests/test_failures.py, the two tests test_failure_kind_incomplete_for_execute_incomplete_holds and test_failure_signature_for_incomplete_uses_head_and_dirty_set):
1. Remove both patch.object(bus, "read", return_value=[]) stubs: these tests must run against the shared harness bus so they prove the KeyError is gone under full-suite ordering.
2. Give EVERY task dict built in both tests its own 'id' (the execute_incomplete holds in the subTest loop, the hold with resume_hint missing, the ordinary partial_output holds, the gate_red one), each unique and named by no review row, e.g. 'T-incomplete-quota', 'T-incomplete-nohint'.
3. The task() helper in the signature test gives every dict the same id: give it an id parameter so each built task has a distinct id (the id is not part of the signature, so equal-signature pairs still hash equal). Keep the hardcoded sha256 gate_red assertion and every other existing assertion.

Verify: commit first. Then, in the foreground, run tests/test_failures.py, then the whole tests directory once with the same test command .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh uses (read the hook for it); report failures only and state in the result that the full-directory run happened and its outcome. Never background a command.
acceptance: tests/test_failures.py::test_failure_kind_incomplete_for_execute_incomplete_holds: passes: failure_kind returns 'incomplete' for hold_reason 'execute_incomplete: no commits' and for 'execute_incomplete: uncommitted changes' with an ordinary partial_output such as 'non-JSON output (rc=143): ' even when partial_output contains the word 'conflict'; returns 'quota' when partial_output contains 'usage limit reached', 'permissions' when it contains 'permission denied', 'environment' when it contains 'ModuleNotFoundError'; a hold with resume_hint missing returns 'incomplete'; existing kinds for gate_red and review holds are unchanged

tests/test_failures.py::test_failure_signature_for_incomplete_uses_head_and_dirty_set: passes: for pipeline.failure_kind 'incomplete', failure_signature differs for two holds with different resume_hint.head or different dirty sets, is equal for identical ones regardless of dirty-path order, treats a missing head as empty, and the signature of a gate_red hold is unchanged from before this change for the same input

tests/test_daemon.py::test_auto_fix_round_files_round_for_execute_incomplete_hold: passes: auto_fix_round files 'fix round 1' with fix_round_for the held id for a held task 'execute_incomplete: no commits' (pipeline.failure_kind 'incomplete', pipeline.auto_fix_route 'routine_incomplete'); a second pass files nothing; a hold whose partial_output carries a quota marker gets no round and no escalation notify; an identical second incomplete hold in the same lineage is escalated as repeated; with auto_fix_rounds 2 a third incomplete hold in the lineage gets no round; with [planner].autonomous True and routes enabled the incomplete round is still filed without calling decision.route; a task with status 'failed' and reason 'non-JSON output (rc=1): ' gets no round and no pipeline write

tests/test_daemon.py::test_fix_round_note_fences_leftovers_and_guards_missing_worktree: passes: the round spec for an incomplete hold whose worktree exists contains a data fence with the hold_reason, the head, the worktree path and each recorded dirty path, and no diff hunk; a dirty path containing three backticks cannot close the fence; partial_output appears inside the failure-text fence; when the held worktree path does not exist the note reads 'worktree: missing', says the leftovers are not recoverable and does not name the path; a gate_red round renders an empty incomplete note

result.summary: The diff matches the spec for tests/test_failures.py. Both patch.object(bus, 'read') stubs are gone, so the tests run against the shared harness bus. Every task dict now has its own unique id. The signature test's task() helper takes an id parameter, and the hardcoded gate_red sha256 assertion and the other existing assertions are kept. I read only the diff and did not run the tests or check the gate result.

comments.issue: The id 'T-incomplete-quota' is attached to the 'execute_incomplete: no commits' case, but the quota case is a separate loop below. The name misleads, though it is unique and harmless.
